audit.whatIsWrong: The chart's enums and its own whys disagree on four rows (whys[0] Gragas vs win[0] Skill; whys[3] Illaoi vs win[3] Skill; whys[4] Gragas vs win[4] Skill; whys[6] Gragas vs win[6] Illaoi), AND the already-written mirror set a chart (Gragas/Gragas/Skill/Skill/Gragas/Skill/Illaoi) that contradicts this packet's chart (Gragas/Illaoi/Illaoi/Illaoi/Gragas/Illaoi/Gragas).
audit.why: Two authoritative sources give different answers, and the mirror's version reads as a Gragas-favoured lane against a 53.21% Illaoi win rate over 624 games. Guessing a chart here would ship a wrong power shift to a paying user.
audit.corrected: NO chart edit proposed — deliberately deferred to the user, see questionsForUser. The prose that does not depend on the chart is corrected instead.

audit.whatIsWrong: The level-6 spike gave no number for Explosive Cask and rested on an unverifiable claim.
audit.why: Explosive Cask is 100/85/70s and 1000 range; that cooldown is what makes baiting it worth doing.
audit.corrected: spikes[1] and mid now carry the 100s figure and the bait instruction.

audit.whatIsWrong: Body Slam was described only as 'his escape' with no cooldown, and the decisive grounding interaction was absent. spikes[1], mid and whys[4] all asserted that Explosive Cask 'cancels your R animation' — that is not in Riot's text and is not something the kit file can confirm.
audit.why: Body Slam (E) is 14/13.5/13/12.5/12s and is a stun as much as an escape. Leap of Faith carries the grounding flag, so it shuts Body Slam off entirely — the single best fact in this matchup.
audit.corrected: Cooldown block, dosFull[0].d and report[5].t now carry the 14s figure, the stun, and the grounding. The unverifiable animation-cancel claim is replaced by the verifiable knockback in all three places it appeared.

audit.why: Happy Hour heals on every skill use, and the missing-interactions file calls for Grievous Wounds. report[8] already prescribes Executioner's Calling early.

edits.before: - Gragas Body Slam: matchup-defining — His escape. Punish the cooldown. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Body Slam (E): 14s at rank 1 — his stun and his escape; when it is down he cannot leave your tentacles. - Explosive Cask (R): 100s, knocks you off the field. - Harsh Lesson (W): flat 4s. - Test of Spirit (E): 16s.

edits.before: His escape. Punish the cooldown. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: Body Slam is both his stun and his escape, 14s at rank 1 — punish.

edits.before: Track Gragas's Body Slam: His escape. Punish the cooldown. When it is down — Slam him in your field.
edits.after: Body Slam (E) is 14s: it stuns as well as escapes, and Leap of Faith grounds it so he cannot dash out.

edits.before: Gragas spikes here — his R Explosive Cask can knock you out of your tentacle field and cancel your R animation, so respect his ult before committing.
edits.after: Gragas spikes here — Explosive Cask is 100s at rank 1 and knocks you clear of your tentacle field, so bait it before you commit Leap of Faith.

edits.before: From level 2 through 5 you own the tempo: W Harsh Lesson onto him when Body Slam is down, seed tentacles, and pin an E Test of Spirit. Watch level 6 — his R Explosive Cask can cancel your Leap and displace you off the field.
edits.after: From level 2 through 5 you own the tempo: Harsh Lesson is a flat 4s leap, so re-engage every time Body Slam (E) sits on its 14s cooldown. At 6, Explosive Cask knocks you clear off your own tentacles — bait it before you commit.

edits.before: Gragas-favoured: level 6 R Explosive Cask knocks you out of tentacles and cancels your Leap.
edits.after: Gragas-favoured: level 6 Explosive Cask knocks you clear out of your tentacle field.

notes: Chart deliberately NOT touched: the already-written mirror (gragas__illaoi) and this packet give different charts, and the mirror's version reads Gragas-favoured against a 53.21% Illaoi win rate. Flagged rather than guessed. Substantive fix shipped: Leap of Faith grounds Body Slam, so ulting after he commits means he cannot dash out — that was absent. Also killed the claim, repeated in three fields, that Explosive Cask cancels Leap of Faith's animation; Riot's text says only knockback.
